.stock-page{min-height:100vh;background:var(--color-bg-page);color:var(--color-text-primary);padding:var(--space-6);display:grid;gap:var(--space-5)}.filter-bar{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(180px,280px) minmax(180px,280px) 1fr;align-items:end;gap:var(--space-3);padding:var(--space-4);border:1px solid var(--color-border-subtle);border-radius:var(--radius-panel);background:var(--color-bg-surface)}.filter-summary{margin:0 0 var(--space-2);justify-self:end;color:var(--color-text-muted);font-size:var(--text-body)}.review-layout{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(300px,.82fr) minmax(390px,1.18fr);gap:var(--space-4);min-height:620px}.exception-list{min-width:0;align-self:start;overflow:hidden;border:1px solid var(--color-border-subtle);border-radius:var(--radius-panel);background:var(--color-bg-surface)}.list-heading{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:baseline;justify-content:space-between;gap:var(--space-2);padding:var(--space-4);border-bottom:1px solid var(--color-border-subtle)}.list-heading h2{margin:0;font-size:var(--text-section-title);line-height:var(--leading-section-title);font-weight:var(--font-weight-semibold)}.list-heading span{color:var(--color-text-muted);font-size:var(--text-caption)}.exception-row{width:100%;height:auto;min-height:76px;border:0;border-radius:0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--color-border-subtle);padding:var(--space-3) var(--space-4);display:flex;justify-content:space-between;text-align:left;white-space:normal}.exception-row:last-child{border-bottom:0}.exception-row.is-selected{background:var(--color-bg-selected);box-shadow:inset 3px 0 0 var(--color-action-primary)}.row-main,.row-evidence{display:flex;min-width:0;flex-direction:column;gap:var(--space-1)}.row-main{align-items:flex-start}.row-main strong{font-size:var(--text-body);color:var(--color-text-primary)}.row-main small{font-size:var(--text-caption);color:var(--color-text-muted)}.row-evidence{align-items:flex-end}.row-evidence>strong{font-size:var(--text-caption);color:var(--color-text-secondary)}.detail-slot{min-width:0;display:flex}.detail-slot>article{max-height:720px}.empty-state{display:grid;gap:var(--space-2);place-content:center;min-height:220px;padding:var(--space-6);text-align:center;color:var(--color-text-muted)}.modal-body{display:grid;gap:var(--space-4)}.modal-body p{margin:0;color:var(--color-text-secondary)}.modal-actions{display:flex;justify-content:flex-end;gap:var(--space-2)}.order-summary{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr auto;gap:var(--space-2);padding:var(--space-3);border-radius:var(--radius-control);background:var(--color-bg-subtle);font-size:var(--text-body)}.order-summary span{color:var(--color-text-muted)}@media(max-width:860px){.stock-page{padding:var(--space-4)}.filter-bar{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}.filter-summary{grid-column:1/-1;justify-self:start;margin:0}.review-layout{grid-template-columns:1fr}.detail-slot>article{max-height:none}}@media(max-width:620px){.filter-bar{grid-template-columns:1fr}.filter-summary{grid-column:auto}.exception-row{gap:var(--space-2)}}

limitations: Conservative matched-style evidence, not a full CSS cascade or React component provenance proof.
Conflicting declarations, unknown variables and shorthand-only properties remain unassessed. Sampling is capped at 120 eligible elements and diversified by rendered region.

A shared bundle is never treated as positive generated adherence. Anonymous rules require a unique exact generated selector/property/value and complete matched-rule declaration set; conditional or ambiguous source rules remain unknown.

Intrinsic tag/class matches are reviewer-facing generated-origin candidates only. Shared components can assemble identical classes dynamically, so they remain unknown and unassessed without direct stylesheet provenance.
adherence.method: Equal average of available dimension percentages; each is conforming / assessed. Shared-library observations are excluded. Unknown provenance is unassessed. Static JSX is not proof of rendering. Coverage describes inspected evidence, not the entire app.

limitations: Conservative matched-style evidence, not a full CSS cascade or React component provenance proof.
Conflicting declarations, unknown variables and shorthand-only properties remain unassessed. Sampling is capped at 120 eligible elements and diversified by rendered region.

A shared bundle is never treated as positive generated adherence. Anonymous rules require a unique exact generated selector/property/value and complete matched-rule declaration set; conditional or ambiguous source rules remain unknown.

Intrinsic tag/class matches are reviewer-facing generated-origin candidates only. Shared components can assemble identical classes dynamically, so they remain unknown and unassessed without direct stylesheet provenance.
